gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-kannada: Friendly from the first glance, Nasalization floats its letters well apart. Anek Kannada then stacks tall, squared-off lowercase beneath that spacing, so the heading floats while the text stands firmly planted.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-chocolate-cla: Chocolate Classical Sans reads like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut. Nasalization keeps every stroke uniform and spaced wide, so nudge the body size up and let its sizable lowercase do the talking.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-fresca: Nasalization has a c opened like a pair of calipers. Shrink the heading and that spacing gets lost, while Fresca, a plain sans with short ascenders over big bowls, keeps its counters open.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, with ascender tops sitting just shy of the x-height line. Beneath Nasalization, a long run of text would read smoothly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-gafata: Nasalization cuts every stem and curve from one gauge of tubing, with floating letters set well apart. But Gafata stands tall beneath it, short stalks over a wide-eyed lowercase e.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hind-guntur: Loose, floating and friendly, Nasalization sets the tone up top. Make the heading small and that spacing fades, while Hind Guntur, a plain sans whose tall forms look stamped from metal, holds firm.
